typesense:explore.greeting:
*Earth... Once of civilization cradle, now ruined wasteland with roaming near anarchy society. Clear air not existing here anymore. Lot's patogens been used as weapon. Lot of death, and more will happend soon. But for now, it's just near heavy polluted planet with new generation of humanity. A humanity who is famous of theirs increditable adaptation and survivability.*
  *You're awake in cage. Such a cage used in past for animals, but locals "upgraded" if it's can name it for storing humans like you are. You are naked: A total nobody with nothing. Well not so nobody but still regural settler in this wasteland. Until now. You don't remember history of world. But you remember few things about surviving and other science subjects and maybe "few" things about building, logistic and others stuff what been useless in pre-war Earth society. Why you ask? Just because you hand't rich parents and own buisness what allowed you to spend time on whatever you wanted.*
  *Wandering in you hybride role cage and thinking about you life before war and still trying remember how you ended in cage days passed. Then days become weeks and so on. You not getting hungry, nore thirsty, not even aging after years in that cage.*
typesense:explore.name: Post-Nuclear Earth
typesense:explore.title: Global warming and nuclear war = polluted Earth. Or it's as looks from a side. And you left here.

title_i18n.de: Globale Erwärmung und Atomkrieg = verschmutzte Erde. Oder so sieht es von außen aus. Und du bist hier zurückgeblieben.
